from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys
ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']
blocked=['unit-acyclic-coset-source-review-sol-r1','path-invariant-classification-primary-comparison-sol-r2','code-loop','polynexus','crown','tournament','transitive-bunkbed','bunkbed','hat-','formal']
reads=[];matches=[];skips=[]
for name in json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text()):
 if any(x in name.lower() for x in blocked):skips.append(name);continue
 p=Path(name)
 if not p.is_file():continue
 b=p.read_bytes();reads.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
 s=b.decode()
 if any(re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+str(i)+r'(?!\d)',s) for i in ids):
  print('MATCH',name,s);matches.append({'path':name,'text':s})
def w(n,o):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path('write_lane.py').resolve()),n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
w('history-screen.json',{'reads':reads,'protected_filtered_before_open':skips,'matches':matches,'no_embedded_following':True})
print('HISTORY',len(reads),'read',len(skips),'excluded',len(matches),'matches')
